title: Best Social Listening Tools for Startups and Small Teams in 2026
summary: The best social listening tools for startups and small teams in 2026, ranked by price, TikTok coverage, and setup speed — no sales call required to see pricing.
body_markdown:
**TL;DR:** For startups and small teams in 2026, Awario is the cheapest self-serve entry point at $29/month billed annually, though it skips TikTok entirely. Mentionlytics and BrandMentions sit in the $49–79/month range with TikTok covered at the caption level, while Brand24 costs more ($199/month annually) but has the deepest TikTok-specific tooling of the group. Mention, once a popular startup pick, has pulled its self-serve pricing entirely and now requires a sales call for a custom quote.


Most of the best social listening tools for startups and small teams in 2026 are still built for enterprise procurement, not a two-person marketing team with a company card. If you're a founder or the entire marketing department, you don't have three weeks for a sales cycle — you need pricing you can see today and a trial you can start tonight. That's the real test this list applies: no sales call required to see a price, no enterprise minimums, and TikTok coverage that actually matches where your customers spend time. This piece ranks four tools that pass that test — Awario, Mentionlytics, BrandMentions, and Brand24 — cheapest to priciest, plus one once-popular pick that quietly failed it this year.


## What separates the best social listening tools for startups from enterprise bloat?


A startup-ready social listening tool needs three things: pricing you can see without booking a call, TikTok coverage that matches your channel mix, and a setup simple enough for a non-analyst to run alone.


**Self-serve** : pricing and trial access you can get without booking a call or waiting on a sales rep — you see the number, you enter a card (or skip it), you're in the product. That single criterion is what separates every tool below from the one that didn't make the list.


Beyond self-serve pricing, a few things matter more than a long feature checklist when you're picking your first tool:


-


**Transparent tiers** — published pricing at every level, not just an entry price with everything else "contact sales"


-


**TikTok or video coverage** — if your growth is happening on short-form video, a tool that only tracks text misses the conversation entirely


-


**A no-commitment trial** — you should be able to test real data before you pay, ideally without a credit card


One thing worth watching as you grow: every tool on this list caps out at caption, hashtag, or comment-level TikTok monitoring at these entry prices. Real analysis of what's happening on-screen or in the audio track sits behind a much higher tier, or isn't offered at all. That's a reasonable trade for a first tool. It stops being reasonable once TikTok video content becomes the actual blocker to understanding your audience — more on that below.


## The 4 best social listening tools for startups, ranked by price

**Awario** — $29/month billed annually, the cheapest self-serve entry point. Awario Starter runs $49/month paid month-to-month or $29/month billed annually, with 30,000 mentions a month and 3 tracked topics for one user, plus API access included free (Source:[Awario Pricing, 2026](https://awario.com/pricing/) ). The catch is real: no TikTok coverage at all, video tracking tops out at YouTube and Vimeo — we've already covered[this TikTok coverage gap](https://syncly.app/blog/awario-alternatives-for-8-tools-compared-on-tiktok-coverage-pricing-and-reviews) in more depth. Awario also asks for a product description and competitor names during setup, since it's built to power its "Leads" feature and not just monitoring, which shows up in a lower G2 score of 3.9/5 across roughly 48-50 reviews, with setup cited as slower than its rivals (Source:[G2 — Awario, 2026](https://www.g2.com/sellers/awario) ; corroborated via search aggregation, 2026).


Trial: 7 days, no credit card required. Best for: startups whose audience isn't on TikTok yet and who want the lowest possible price.


**Mentionlytics** — $49/month billed annually, TikTok included from day one. Mentionlytics Basic costs $69/month paid monthly or $49/month annually, for 5,000 mentions a month across 3 keywords, and unlike Awario, TikTok is covered on every single tier, including this entry plan (Source:[Mentionlytics Pricing, 2026](https://www.mentionlytics.com/pricing/) ). It also carries the strongest reviewer score of the four: roughly 4.9/5 on G2 across about 112 reviews, with feedback that it "covers the essentials without enterprise bloat" (Source:[G2 — Mentionlytics, 2026](https://www.g2.com/products/mentionlytics/reviews) ). Best for: a first tool when TikTok visibility matters more than a high mention ceiling.


**BrandMentions** — $79/month billed annually, the middle ground on price and keywords. BrandMentions Starter lists at $99/month billed quarterly, working out to roughly $79/month on an annual plan, with 5,000 mentions a month, 5 keywords, and one user (Source:[BrandMentions Pricing, 2026](https://brandmentions.com/pricing.php) ). TikTok is covered at the caption, hashtag, and comment level — not the deeper spoken-word or on-screen-text layer (Source:[BrandMentions TikTok coverage, 2026](https://brandmentions.com/blog/track-brand-mentions-tiktok/) ; corroborated via search aggregation, 2026). Best for: teams that want more keyword slots than Mentionlytics' entry tier without jumping all the way to Brand24's price.


**Brand24** — $199/month billed annually, the deepest TikTok tooling of the four. Brand24 Individual costs $249/month paid monthly or $199/month billed annually, the priciest entry tier here, for 2,000 mentions a month and 3 keywords, with API access sold separately as a $149/month add-on (Source:[Brand24 Pricing, 2026](https://brand24.com/pricing/) ). What the premium buys you: real TikTok transcription, not just caption-level tracking, making it the most video-capable of the group at this price point. G2 reviewers rate it around 4.6/5 across roughly 355 reviews and describe it as the simplest setup flow of the four, built around two-step alert creation (Source:[G2 — Brand24, 2026](https://www.g2.com/products/brand24/reviews) ).


Trial: 14 days. Best for: startups where reviewing TikTok content is the actual job, not a nice-to-have. For[the full price breakdown](https://syncly.app/blog/mentionlytics-vs-brand24-vs-awario-budget-social-listening-compared) across these three tools' TikTok coverage specifically, this piece's sibling comparison goes deeper.


## Why Mention Didn't Make This List


Mention no longer qualifies as a startup tool because it removed its self-serve pricing entirely — the only option now is a demo-gated custom quote.


A direct fetch of Mention's own pricing page confirms this: self-serve tiers are gone, and the page shows only a single demo-gated "Company" plan with the price hidden behind "$" placeholders (Source:[Mention Pricing, 2026](https://mention.com/en/pricing/) ). As recently as last year, Mention ran a self-serve ladder from roughly $29 to $249 a month across Solo, Starter, Pro, and ProPlus plans — the kind of ladder a startup could climb without ever talking to sales. That ladder is gone now. Third-party aggregators report the new Company plan reportedly starts around $599/month, though that figure is an unconfirmed sales quote rather than a published price (Source: search aggregation, 2026).


Here's why that matters for this list specifically: Mention fails the one test every other tool here passes. You can't see a number without booking a call, and per this piece's own definition of self-serve, that disqualifies it from a startup shortlist regardless of what its feature set looks like on paper.


Mention isn't a broken product. It's just no longer built for a team evaluating its first tool on a Tuesday afternoon, card in hand. If your team eventually needs what a fully custom, sales-assisted platform offers, that's a different conversation — but you won't get to have it without a demo call first.


## Key Takeaways


-


Awario is the cheapest self-serve entry point ($29/month billed annually) but has no TikTok coverage at all.


-


Mentionlytics ($49/month) and BrandMentions ($79/month) both include TikTok at the caption level starting on their entry tiers.


-


Brand24 costs more ($199/month) but is the only one of the four offering TikTok transcription, not just caption tracking.


-


Mention has removed self-serve pricing entirely — the only option now is a demo-gated custom quote, reportedly starting around $599/month.


-


Every tool on this list caps out at caption-level TikTok monitoring at these prices; real video and audio analysis sits behind a much higher tier or isn't offered.


If you need a number today, start with Awario or Mentionlytics — both let you see pricing and start a trial without a sales call, and one of them actually covers TikTok. The real dividing line among these four tools isn't price, it's TikTok depth, and none of them go past caption-level monitoring at these tiers.
